source.description:
## PROBLEM
~/.claude/settings.json (raw, not xtrm-managed) has a PostToolUse hook row that calls python3 $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/skills/service-skills/scripts/drift_detector.py check-hook WITHOUT a file-existence guard. When the project doesn't have that file (which is the normal case in ~/dev/core), every Write/Edit tool call fails post-run with 'No such file or directory'.

The xtrm-managed hook row (which uses ~/.xtrm/skills/default/... path) already has the sh guard '[ -f "$p" ] && python3 ... ; exit 0'. Only the raw settings.json entry is unguarded.

PR #500 (xtrm-igx6a) landed prune-hook-rows for the xtrm-managed drift; the raw entry survived because plugin-era-cleanup only touches xtrm-managed rows.

## SUCCESS
Raw entry either removed or guarded. Editing files in ~/dev/core no longer errors post-Write/Edit.

## SCOPE
- ~/.claude/settings.json (raw, user-owned — cannot be edited by xtrm-tools directly)
- Option A: instruct operator to remove the row (fastest).
- Option B: extend plugin-era-cleanup.ts prune-hook-rows to also match raw entries by scriptPath pattern (repeat xtrm-igx6a's fix class).
- Option C: leave the row + add a permanent guarded stub at .claude/skills/service-skills/scripts/drift_detector.py in the repo (least clean; the stub becomes vendored).

## NON_GOALS
- Rewriting the service-skills class entirely.

## CONSTRAINTS
- P3 — currently unblocked with a manual stub committed in cwd; not tracked, not shipped.

## VALIDATION
- After fix: grep 'drift_detector.py' ~/.claude/settings.json returns no unguarded entries.
- Editing any file in ~/dev/core with the stub REMOVED does not error at PostToolUse.

## OUTPUT
Chosen option + one-line rationale + PR link (if Option B).
source.title: core: raw drift_detector hook in ~/.claude/settings.json lacks [-f] guard
